thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: SEV2 — autoscaler_backlog_prod triggered (queue backlog 58,200 for 9m)
pagerduty-bot: page routed to rotation (eng-oncall) — escalation: 2m -> TL on-call
Sam R.: ack. I'm looking at the autoscaler dashboard.
Aisha K.: Ack from me as well. Pulling logs for the scale-controller.
Sam R.: Quick snapshot: p99 gen latency ~7.8s, error rate 3.4% (inference-api-prod), active backlog 58,200, sustained for ~9m. HPA shows current replicas=18 desired=120 (maxReplicas=200). Events: scaling failed: "quotaExceeded: regional-instance-quota".
Tom Y.: Is the node auto-provisioner set to create GPU SKUs? Cloud console shows failed requests for n2d-gpu-8 due to quota.
Aisha K.: Confirmed. The autoscaler queued VM requests but the cloud quota for GPUs in the region is exhausted. There are remaining CPU-only quotas.
eng-oncall: Triage options: (1) route traffic to prod-us-central fallback pool, (2) temporarily shed low-priority ops jobs, (3) spin CPU-only worker pool and move non-GPU tasks, (4) open cloud quota emergency.
Sam R.: Doing actions 1+3 now.
Sam R.: Routing change: update traffic split -> prod-us-central 30% (using our traffic-gateway split). Command: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: gateway-split
  namespace: prod
data:
  weights: \"us-central=30,us-west=70\"
EOF`
Aisha K.: Spawning CPU-only node pool (burst-cpu-pool, size 60, machine-type n2-highmem-16) via cloud CLI.
eng-oncall: Note — some inference tasks require GPUs. We'll need to prioritize which pods can run on CPU nodes. Use nodeSelector + tolerations to reschedule non-GPU workers.
Sam R.: Applying a runtime config to mark low-priority batch jobs with label `spillover=true` and patching deployment to `nodeSelector: {\"cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool\": \"burst-cpu-pool\"}` for those replicas.
Aisha K.: Patch applied. Many batch pods transitioned to Pending -> Running on CPU nodes. Backlog trimming started.
support-runner: CS/Support update: creating incident INC-8479, posting starter blurb on status page: "Investigating elevated latency and errors in US-WEST due to capacity shortage."
Tom Y.: Manual mitigation attempt: `kubectl scale deploy inference-worker -n prod --replicas=220` — applied as an override, but scheduling still limited by available nodes.
Aisha K.: Cloud support ticket opened (CS-87421) with priority P1 for quota bump. ETA unknown. We can also request temporary quota from partner rep.
Sam R.: Additional mitigation — enable request-shedding for low-priority routes: toggled feature flag `ShedLowPriorityRequests=true` via config-service. This rejects non-essential requests with 429 to protect core traffic.
eng-oncall: Metrics after changes: backlog 58,200 -> 24,900 in ~12m. p99 latency down to 3.6s. Error rate down to 1.2%.
Tom Y.: Good progress. Cloud ticket responded: can provision additional GPU quota but requires org approval, ETA 18-40m.
Sam R.: If quota arrives, plan: (1) create gpu-pool-hot (taint: gpu-only), (2) cordon cpu pool to keep it available for spillover non-GPU tasks, (3) migrate GPU pods to gpu-pool-hot.
Aisha K.: Meanwhile, rolling limiters for inference-api per-customer set to 60% of usual for affected region. Support notified enterprise accounts flagged as impacted for potential replays.
support-runner: Notifying top-10 enterprise customers with template: "We are experiencing degraded inference performance in US-WEST. Engineers are actively mitigating. We will provide updates every 30 minutes."
Tom Y.: Observed a stuck scale event in cloud logs: `scale-controller: instance-creation: createVM failed: quotaExceeded: \"GPUs (nvidia-tesla)\"`. We should add fallback node types (a100 vs t4) in provisioning config.
Sam R.: Starting to provision mixed GPU types using alternate quotas: `gcloud compute instance-templates create gpu-alt-template --machine-type n2d-standard-16 --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1` then create managed instance group. If T4s come up we can run lighter models.
Aisha K.: Alt GPU pool creating. Some pods scheduled onto T4s; models with OOM behavior will be constrained. Monitoring for model failures.
eng-oncall: Current state summary (handoff snapshot): backlog 24,900, p99 3.6s, 5xx 1.2%, routing 30% -> us-central, CPU spillover pool running, GPU alt pool provisioning in progress. Cloud quota request pending (CS-87421). Support incident INC-8479 created.
Sam R.: I'll remain primary for mitigation for the next 20m. If unresolved, handoff to Tom. Actions assigned:
- Tom: validate gpu-alt-pool and migrate GPU pods when stable
- Aisha: keep pushing cloud quota + confirm org approval path
- support-runner: update status page and customer comms every 30m
- eng-oncall: monitor PagerDuty for any escalation and watch backlog metrics

Tom Y.: ack. I'll take over if there's no resolution by 1765554360.
Sam R.: handing off now to Tom. Linking runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/scale-controller-backlog
support-runner: Logged for postmortem. (label: capacity-exhaustion). :white_check_mark:
Tom Y.: taking over. Current: backlog 24,900, waiting on GPU quota. Continuing mitigation and will update in-thread.
